description: Get public StillOnline status JSON by status page slug. Use this to inspect customer-facing uptime without exposing private account data.

slug.description: Public status page slug or ID from a StillOnline /s/{slug} URL.

name: status.get

outputSchema.description: Public StillOnline status payload for the requested status page, including page metadata, checks, current status, and incident information when available.

title: Get Public Status
